General
1.1. Metin2 Singleplayer is a free fan project: the server runs on your own computer and the world is populated by bots (Playerbots). The project is not affiliated with Gameforge or Webzen.[ENTER]1.2. Releases and updates of the project are published on GitHub: github.com/TieruYT/metin2-playerbots.[ENTER]1.3. You play at your own risk. The project is provided "as is", without any warranty.
Rules
2.1. On your own server you play as you like. The admin / admin account is the test account of your installation.[ENTER]2.2. If you share the server with friends, you are its administrator and you keep order: fair play, respect for others, no cheating and no spoiling other people's game.[ENTER]2.3. Do not pass the package off as your own and do not make money from it. Since version 2.2.55 the project is licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (the LICENSE file in the server folder): you may use it and share the official packages unchanged if you credit the author and do not make money from it; you may not share adaptations or separate distributions. 3.1. Development, testing and the test server cost time and money. If you enjoy the project, you can buy the authors a coffee: buycoffee.to/metin2-playerbots.[ENTER]3.2. Support is entirely voluntary and unlocks nothing in the game.
Community and help
4.1. The project's Discord: discord.gg/DyCxXdZtnV - report bugs, ideas and questions there; news of new versions appears there too.[ENTER]4.2. When you report a bug, attach the log bundle from the launcher (DIAGNOSTICS, "Collect logs (ZIP)"). Without it, hardly anything can be fixed.
Privacy
5.1. Everything runs locally: the client connects only to 127.0.0.1, and the server opens no ports to the outside.[ENTER]5.2. The game sends your data nowhere. The launcher connects to GitHub only to check whether there is a new version.
Changes to these rules
